commands: uname -a; pidin ar; pci-tool -v; echo PROBE_BASE_DONE
chmod 700 /data/home/root/hostshare; echo HS_BINARY_BEGIN; cat /data/home/root/hostshare; echo; echo HS_BINARY_END

/data/home/root/hostshare --pci-line --mount > /data/home/root/mount.log 2>&1 & HS_PID=$!; echo HS_PID=$HS_PID; sleep 2; cat /data/home/root/mount.log; cat /mnt/host/hello.txt; echo MOUNT_CAT_RC=$?; ls -1 /mnt/host; echo MOUNT_DONE
kill -KILL $HS_PID; wait $HS_PID; echo KILL_WAIT_RC=$?; cat /data/home/root/mount.log; cat /mnt/host/hello.txt; echo AFTER_STOP_RC=$?; echo STOP_DONE

/data/home/root/hostshare --pci-line --mount-drop > /data/home/root/drop.log 2>&1 & HS_DROP_PID=$!; echo HS_DROP_PID=$HS_DROP_PID; sleep 2; cat /data/home/root/drop.log; cat /mnt/host/hello.txt; echo DROP_CAT_RC=$?; /data/home/root/hostshare --checksum /mnt/host/hello.txt; echo DROP_CHECK_RC=$?; pidin -p $HS_DROP_PID info; echo DROP_DONE
kill -TERM $HS_DROP_PID; wait $HS_DROP_PID; echo DROP_TERM_RC=$?; cat /data/home/root/drop.log; echo FINAL_DONE
copy_route: ksh builtin printf %b octal chunks128 to snapshot data volume; no image build
copy_verification: readback cat bytes compared to ELF with explicit tty ONLCR transformation; no target hash utility required

n5_stop.signal: SIGKILL after idle completed reads. No DMA quiesce by killed process; remounter resets. No active/in-flight crash safety claim.

n5_drop_remount.least_privilege_scope: exact ability drops and IO reacquire denial only, not a security audit

low 0
high 0
max 0
oom 0
oom_kill 0
oom_group_kill 0
sock_throttled 0
